responsibility: Defines the place database used by BIR to represent locals, temporaries, constants, projections, scopes, and loans for borrow checking. It owns the Place structure and Kind taxonomy, scope tree, loan records, and the PlaceDB allocator/lookup APIs that create variables, temporaries, constants, field/index/deref paths, per-place free regions, and borrow relationships, so this file is the core storage model for lvalues and path-based borrow-tracked state within a single BIR function.
